notes.title: Update notes for May 10 2021
notes.notes:
- New achievement added: Investigator!

- New building added in town

- Extra tweak to zombie hit radius

- Fixed background music sometimes stopping in rare cases after leaving certain areas

notes.title: Update notes for May 6 2021
notes.notes:
- Fixed zombie hit radius bug.

- Player spawn points adjusted slightly in town area in response to a bug I've been unable to replicate. Spawning on load shouldn't have been an issue so it may have been an anomaly, however please do let me know if you encounter problems loading.

- Increased ammo box amount

notes.title: Update notes for May 5 2021
notes.notes:
A small update, but necessary for some!

- Snap Turning has now been added as per user suggestion, and enabled by default. If you prefer smooth turning, you will find a toggle in your hand menu. 

-  Zombies now deal less damage in the first areas.

- Minor bugfixes.

Need to get in touch? Find me on Twitter!

notes.title: Update notes for May 3 2021
notes.notes:
- More interactable objects: Pickups, doors, cupboards, drawers, etc. For example, you can now shut yourself in the diner if you need a breather! More will be added & fleshed out soon.

- Hint/control instructions added in the starting basement.

- New achievement: Basketball Hero.

- Food/drink on food stalls now consumable.

- Minor bugfixes.

(Also: Snap Turning is coming very soon!)

notes.title: Zombies! Launch Update
notes.notes:
Hello, and a big thank you to everyone that already purchased Zombies!

While I can say that some things haven't exactly gone smoothly, the good news is that there will be some updates on the way.  


 More interactable items have been requested most of all, and you will see more appearing in game soon. 

 More events with cars, NPCs, dialogue and other audio. 

 More hints - while I want things to remain fairly "open", there will be some more helpful hints added here and there.

 Bugfixes - the game has been tested but I am working solo and there are inevitably bugs that may have been overlooked. If you've found an issue, please let me know! Twitter is ideal.


One last thing I would like to mention is physics. While interactable objects do have of course basic physics, more complex physics are out of the scope of this project for now. As said, I am working solo in my spare time, and at some point I have to keep things on a smaller scale in order to move forward onto other projects in the future.

Thank you!
